findings.text: `public/framework/ext/Shots/Shots.mjs:486-493` resizes the viewport to the whole page height before shooting. That makes `100vh`/`vh`-sized sections stretch to 4000px, so the picture is not what a user sees, and rounds diff as "changed" for the wrong reason. Keep the normal viewport height and use `page.screenshot({fullPage:true})`, then cap the height by cropping.

This diff is only the node half (PNG, Diff, Shots, the CLI). The Screenshots tab, the owner's better/not-better click, the automatic trigger in the task process (step-runner, `merge.mjs` gate, `check_page`) and the Figma-page run in the sidebar are all absent. That is fine if build-b lands them; if not, the "automatic, not remembered" ask is unmet.

`Shots.mjs:474-482` reads `resolutions`/`optimalWidth` from `app.router.active`, but nothing in this diff defines those on any template, so every page currently gets the four standard widths. Fine as a hook; say so in `plan.md`.

`public/framework/ext/Shots/runs.jsonl` is committed with a throwaway test round (`css: body{padding:3em}`) whose PNGs are gitignored and so exist nowhere else. Each diff line also stores 100+ tiny regions (`runs.jsonl` line 5 onward); cap the stored list at about 20 so the log stays readable.
`public/framework/ext/Shots/files.jsonl` lists `runs.jsonl` three times, one entry marked `gone`. It looks like a tool artefact; tidy it.

`Shots.mjs:559` ids have one-second resolution, so two runs in the same second share a folder. `is_diff_for`/`is_judge_for` (`Shots.mjs:601-608`) re-read the whole log per line, which is O(n²) as the log grows. `as_url` (`Shots.mjs:567`) keeps `?query`/`#hash`, so such urls get their own history.

The overlay is a plain 16px cell diff. It does not use the earlier linearity filter, and nothing measures whether the overlay helps the model, which the brief asks for. `Shots.test.mjs` covers PNG round-trip and Diff, and its 7 checks are sound. Node-only code under `public/` (`Shots.mjs` imports `../../../../Server/browser.mjs`) is also worth a look given the static-site rule.

The open question is decided: widths from `resolutions`, else `optimalWidth`, else four standards, with height capped at 4000 and flagged `cut`. The "first screen plus full page" alternative is not recorded in this diff, so confirm it is in `plan.md`.
